title: Keep Engram revocation retries independent from unrelated settings edits
outcome: Any Engram settings mutation may opportunistically retry an older unconfirmed authority revocation. If that retry fails, even a deadline-only edit can return 500 after the edit was durably committed and can contend on the project reset fence. Separate best-effort backlog repair from failures caused by the current mutation.
acceptance: An unrelated settings edit is not failed or conflicted solely by an older retryable tombstone; the edit has an unambiguous response matching its durable outcome; retirement initiated by the current request still reports degradation; deterministic retry-failure coverage exists.
